name: Jack Bean

daysToHarvestRange.notes: No SA-specific or FAO/ARC source with a day-count was found; only ECOCROP's generic growing-cycle range (see ecocrop.GMIN/GMAX below).

yield.conditions: sub-humid sub-tropics; figure is a GROUP average, not species-specific

evidence.quote: Annual legumes (Cowpea, Lablab, Velvet bean, Jack bean): 3 – 5 t DM/ha
evidence.doc: Integrated crop and pasture-based livestock production systems – Part 26: Integration of pasture leys with grain crop systems, SA Grain/Grain SA (Table 1), 2019

gaps: No dedicated SA source (DAFF/ARC/KZN DARD/Elsenburg/Grain SA/FAO/scielo/seed-company catalogue) was found that treats jack bean on its own — it appears only as one member of a 4-species group ('Cowpea, Lablab, Velvet bean, Jack bean') in Grain SA's Part 26 summary table, so the 3-5 t DM/ha yield figure is NOT species-specific and is recorded with that caveat.

No SA-specific seed rate, row/in-row spacing, sow-depth, sow-month, N-fixed figure, or days-to-termination were found. A widely circulated '360 kg N/ha' figure and a PMC nodulation study (Eswatini) appeared in web search results, but neither could be opened and verbatim-quoted (PMC blocked the fetch with a reCAPTCHA challenge; the 360 kg N/ha figure only appeared in AI-summarized search text, never in an opened primary document), so per the no-invented-numbers rule neither is used.
Agricol, Barenbrug and Du Toit Agri were searched specifically for a jack bean product page; none was found — jack bean does not appear to be a commercial SA cover-crop seed-catalogue item.
summary: Jack bean could not be substantiated with SA-specific agronomic data from any acceptable source. Only a non-species-specific biomass range (part of a 4-crop group average in a Grain SA table) and the generic FAO ECOCROP climate envelope were found. Sow months, seed rate, spacing, N-fixation and days-to-termination are all gaps; this entry needs a dedicated ARC/DAFF or peer-reviewed SA trial to move past 'unsourced'.
